title: mollugo teretifolia
intro: Mollugo teretifolia, commonly known as Green Purslane, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to various parts of Asia and Australia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Mollugo teretifolia are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties, which may help in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
